name: Wave Power Technology Inc.
summary: Wave Power Technology Inc. specializes in the full spectrum of activities, from research and development to manufacturing and sales, for advanced components designed for high-frequency, high-power, high-voltage, and high-vacuum applications. Their extensive product range includes industrial-grade microwave generators, magnetrons, variable capacitors, various disks, and heating elements. Additionally, they provide electrical feedthroughs, vacuum-sealed windows, ceramic insulators for high-voltage systems, and solutions for vacuum-hermetic welding. The company was established in 2002 and operates from its base in Toufen, Taiwan.
